spec_title: Reverse-Engineering Drawing-Production & Acquisition Agent Roster (ASUS ProArt H7604JV)

target.model: ASUS ProArt StudioBook 16 OLED H7604JI / H7604JV

confirmed_from_pixels.io_board: N7604JV_IAR_BD R2.0 (silkscreen legible on page-22 @ 600 DPI)

unverified_external_assumptions: mainboard P/N '60NB10B0-MB3110' is NOT printed on any inspected page (mylar-covered) - external assumption; operator to confirm.

boardview_revision 'H7604JV Rev 2.1' is NOT from the manual - external assumption; the only board rev confirmed from pixels is the IO board 'R2.0'. Operator to confirm the mainboard .FZ revision before acquisition.

liquid-metal (Conductonaut) TIM is an external/general-knowledge assumption for this SKU - the manual shows kapton/mylar zones (page-20/21) but does NOT state the TIM compound. Treated as a precautionary hazard, not a confirmed fact; operator to verify before rework.

availability_legend.d: not available off-the-shelf / must be derived

guardrails_global: Fidelity ceiling: all photo-derived outputs are illustrative and UNCALIBRATED (no scale/GD&T); never present as dimensioned engineering drawings.
No AI hallucination: never synthesize nets, component values, reference designators, or hidden/back-side traces not visible in a cited page image.
Boardview legality: acquire .FZ/.brd through legitimate channels; no paywall bypass, no DMCA OEM-mirror redistribution; .FZ decryption key sourced separately by the operator.

HAZARD (precautionary, NOT confirmed in manual): high-TDP ProArt SKUs of this class are reported to use conductive liquid-metal TIM on the CPU/GPU die (the manual shows kapton/mylar zones page-20/21 but does not name the compound). Treat the die TIM as potentially conductive — verify before rework; if liquid metal, clean before powering and avoid bridging.
Provenance: the ASUS repair manual is recorded URL-only (category a); page numbers are cited, the PDF is not redistributed in this repo.

agents.name: Connector / Interconnect Map Producer

tools.name: Inkscape
tools.role: trace board outline + label connectors as vector

steps: Import page-19 board photo, deskew and crop in GIMP.
Vector-trace the mainboard outline in Inkscape.
Place each labelled connector (FAN, FFC_USB, LAN_IO_FPC, EDP, SPEAKER, CMOS, BL FPC, LED FFC, K/B FPC, BATTERY, TP FFC) at its photographed location.
Emit an interconnect table (connector -> destination FRU) in draw.io.
agents.fidelity_ceiling: Locational/illustrative; connector positions are relative, not dimensioned.
guardrails: Label only connectors visible on page-19; do not infer pin-level nets.

agents.name: Component-Placement / Assembly Drawing Producer
steps: Catalog the named FRUs from page-06 (top) and page-07 (bottom).
Overlay placement callouts on the board top/bottom photos.
Add variant material zones from page-20 (JI vs JV GPU mylar).
agents.fidelity_ceiling: Board-level FRU placement only; not net-level PCBA assembly.
guardrails: Distinguish H7604JI vs H7604JV explicitly (GPU mylar differs, page-20).

agents.name: Thermal / Airflow Layout Producer
steps: Trace dual-fan + heatpipe layout from page-18.
Annotate intake/exhaust and the numbered screw sequence (1-7).
Add airflow direction arrows (inferred).
agents.fidelity_ceiling: Geometry illustrative; airflow inferred, not CFD-validated.

agents.name: Exploded / Isometric Assembly View Producer
steps: Order FRUs by the disassembly sequence (page-08 + steps page-10..26).
Compose a 2.5D exploded illustration along the stack axis.
Annotate each FRU with its name and removal order.
agents.fidelity_ceiling: Illustrative explosion; no CAD geometry / true dimensions.
guardrails: Do not fabricate hidden internal geometry.
agents.next_best: iFixit-style teardown photography for missing angles.

agents.name: Orthographic / Multi-View Silhouette Producer
steps: Extract the 5 face views from page-05 (Top/Bottom/Right/Left/Rear).
Lay out as orthographic projection with numbered port/feature callouts.
Stamp 'NOT TO SCALE'.
agents.fidelity_ceiling: Silhouette + port locations; UNCALIBRATED (page-05 carries no dimensions).

agents.name: Chassis / Enclosure Outline Producer
steps: Trace outer enclosure outline from page-05 faces.
Add the bottom-case fastener pattern from page-10.

agents.name: Coarse Block / Adjacency Diagram Producer
steps: Derive coarse adjacency (which connector feeds which subsystem) from page-19.
Render as a block diagram with no internal nets.
agents.next_best: Acquire schematic (AG-11) for true block diagram.

agents.name: Major-IC Location Map Producer (burn targeting aid)
steps: Mark CPU and GPU die positions and bracket footprint from page-20/21.
Annotate the kapton/mylar (liquid-metal) hazard zone.
agents.fidelity_ceiling: MAJOR ICs ONLY. Board is mylar-covered: no VRM phases or reference designators legible. Not a full component map.
guardrails: Do NOT label VRM phases / passives — not visible (mylar-covered).
Flag liquid-metal bridging hazard at the CPU/GPU die.
agents.next_best: Acquire boardview (AG-10) for the real component/VRM map.

agents.name: Silkscreen / Legend Transcription Producer
steps: Re-render the mainboard/IO-board regions at 600 DPI (page-20/22).
Transcribe legible slot/connector silkscreen: e.g. WLAN, SSD0, SSD1 (page-20), and IO board name/rev 'N7604JV_IAR_BD R2.0' + connector designators (page-22).
Mark the CPU/GPU area as NOT transcribable (mylar/kapton covered).
agents.fidelity_ceiling: Slot/connector-level silkscreen only; fine-pitch component reference designators (R/C/U) are NOT legible; CPU/GPU zone is mylar-covered. Confirmed at 600 DPI.
guardrails: Transcribe only glyphs actually legible in a cited render; never infer designators.
agents.next_best: Acquire boardview (AG-10) for the full silkscreen/legend.

agents.name: Boardview Acquisition Agent
agents.drawing_type: Boardview (.FZ/.brd) with embedded netlist + test points
steps: Acquire the H7604JV Rev 2.1 boardview .FZ through a legitimate channel.
Obtain the .FZ decryption key separately (operator-sourced).
Open in OpenBoardView; cross-reference connectors against AG-01 (page-19).
guardrails: No paywall bypass; no DMCA OEM-mirror redistribution.
Do not commit the .FZ or its key to this repo.
agents.next_best: If unobtainable: manual net tracing from AG-08 map + DMM (AG-13).

agents.name: Schematic Acquisition Agent
steps: Attempt acquisition of the H7604J schematic from a legitimate paid database.
If unavailable, fall back to deriving partial topology from AG-10 boardview.
agents.fidelity_ceiling: Authoritative if acquired; otherwise derive partial only.

agents.name: Fastener / Torque Schedule Producer
steps: Transcribe the explicit torque table from page-22 (M2x3L, 2.0+/-0.2 kgf-cm, QTY 2).
Collect numbered screw maps from page-18/10/14/25.
Assemble a per-FRU fastener schedule.
agents.fidelity_ceiling: Comprehensive: explicit torque tables appear on every FRU disassembly page (confirmed page-10 bottom case, page-14 battery, page-22 IO board; all 2.0+/-0.2 kgf-cm with per-screw M-specs). A near-complete fastener/torque schedule is producible. Transcribe only printed values.
guardrails: Mark fasteners with no printed torque as 'spec not in manual'.

agents.name: Burn-Triage Workflow Agent
steps: Apply pre-repair safety checklist (page-04) and battery disconnect (page-11).
Cross-reference AG-08 die map + AG-10 boardview rails.
Diode/continuity test power rails around the CPU/VRM burn site.
agents.fidelity_ceiling: Procedure, not a drawing; depends on AG-10 acquisition for net data.
guardrails: HAZARD: liquid-metal TIM is conductive — clean before powering; avoid bridging.
Battery must be disconnected (page-11) before probing.
agents.next_best: X-ray/CT if visual + electrical triage is inconclusive.
